title: Chapter 41 Luxurious Banquet
content:
Chapter 41 Luxurious Banquet

Bond Zhao grinned and directly transformed some of the items he could redeem.

Golden spears, golden armors, war horses, various construction drawings, special tokens, skills, techniques...

Showed them one by one.

While showing it, he also introduced: "The set of skills in my hand is called Opening Heaven Palm. It has thirteen levels in total. Each level can provide players with all attributes +1..."

"This is a bloodthirsty sword with no level restrictions. Each attack can restore life with 30% of the attack power, making you braver as you fight! Become a truly lasting man!"

Finally, Wang Shuo couldn't bear it anymore!

These things are all good things!

If he could get it from Zhao Bond, his strength would definitely increase greatly.

"Can you really exchange these things for me?" Wang Shuo asked doubtfully.

Zhao Bangde showed a harmless smile and said lightly: "Of course, I am just an NPC, what bad intentions can I have?"

"Oh well!"

After that, Wang Shuo handed him a piece of grilled crocodile meat. Since there were a lot of condiments sprinkled on it, it tasted very good!

Zhao Bond took a bite and chewed slowly. Maybe it was because he hadn't eaten for a long time, but he felt very satisfied.

Crisp and refreshing, with a mouthful of aroma, it made him very intoxicated!

"It would be even better if there was a bottle of wine!"

He said to himself.

"I don't have any wine."

Seeing that the other party was taking advantage of the situation, Wang Shuo looked a little unhappy and directly rejected his request.

Bond Zhao grinned and said calmly: "You don't have it, I have it here!"

Immediately afterwards, he took out a small ceramic bottle with "Hundred Flowers Brewing" written on it.

"This bottle of wine only requires 100 energy crystals. You can buy it for me to drink."

Wang Shuo laughed angrily, frowned, and shouted loudly: "I'm afraid you drank too much fake wine! You asked me to buy you your own wine, why are you so thick-skinned?"

"If only it were mine!" Zhao Bond sighed and said helplessly, "I am a warehouse manager."

Wang Shuo was silent for a while, and then decisively refused!

Are you kidding me, 100 energy crystals, did I take the wrong medicine? It's a waste of money.

"No, this is too expensive!" Wang Shuo shook his head like a rattle.

Zhao Bond did not expect Wang Shuo to buy Baihua Brew for him.

So he took out another bottle, this time it only had 10 energy crystals.

Wang Shuo still refused.

"Your minimum consumption is settled with energy crystals!"

"I'll give you a maximum of 10 silver coins if I treat you to a drink, no more!"

Thinking about the purchasing power of 1 gold coin, 10 silver coins are enough to make Wang Shuo feel distressed.

At this time, Wang Shuo thought of Chef Zhang.

Let's see if we can get some wine from him. If we can have some good dishes, I think Zhao Bond will be more satisfied.

Wang Shuo immediately searched for wine and food in the trading house, and actually found the ale brewed by Chef Zhang and the latest dishes.

Wang Shuo directly spent 10 silver coins to buy a luxurious table of wine and food.

It was very sincere, after all, he himself was reluctant to eat like this.

In the stone house, Zhao Bangde's mouth watered when he saw the food and wine prepared by Wang Shuo!

After three rounds of wine and five dishes, the two of them exchanged glasses and seemed to have begun calling themselves brothers!

Although it was ale, Wang Shuo's drinking capacity was really unflattering, and he soon became drunk. Most of the ale he bought was drunk by Zhao Bond!

Zhao Bangde is an old drunkard. He repeatedly urged Wang Shuo to buy wine on the way, which was like a bottomless pit.

Seeing the unconscious Wang Shuo, Zhao Bangde smiled and liked the boy a lot.

Early the next morning, Wang Shuo woke up, still a little dizzy. When he walked out the door, he found that Zhao Bond was boxing.

Unexpectedly, this NPC is also a self-disciplined NPC.

This surprised Wang Shuo!

"You're awake!" Zhao Bond finished the boxing and smiled at Wang Shuo.

"Yes." Wang Shuo came to the well, filled a basin of cold water, washed his face, and suddenly became more awake.

"What kind of boxing are you doing?" Wang Shuo asked casually.

"Do you want to learn? I have many techniques that can be redeemed here."

Wang Shuo suddenly became energetic.

"Before exchanging the skills, let me tell you the basic situation of this copy of Yellow Wind Valley! This is just for the sake of yesterday's table of wine and food."

"It's actually very simple. You first need to repair the camp, kill the monsters outside the camp, exchange items with me, improve your strength, and then kill the final boss here to completely control this dungeon."

"In this way, my mission is completed. From now on, this copy will completely become your back garden."

After hearing Zhao Bond's introduction, Wang Shuo understood a lot, but still had some doubts, so he asked: "The weapons and techniques you showed me yesterday can be redeemed by killing monsters outside?"

"Theoretically, yes, I am responsible for issuing missions to you and distributing rewards! However, there are some good things and the required military merit points that you may not be able to collect in a short time."

"What is the military merit point?"

"Every time you kill an undead monster, you will get military merit points. In this copy, they will be automatically counted and used as a voucher for you to redeem items."

"Let me take a look first. What good things do you have here?"

Half an hour later, Wang Shuo took a breath of cold air.

"How is it? There are a lot of good things!" Zhao Bond smiled proudly.

"The output in this dungeon is of great help to the players in the early stages of the trial. You can say that you have found a treasure."

Zhao Bond was a little envious. If he had been able to get such an opportunity when he was a novice in the trial, he would not have so many regrets!

"Tell me, how did you get this copy?" Zhao Bond asked with interest.

"It's in my territory! I used 500 energy crystals to repair a portal and came over!" Wang Shuo replied casually.

Zhao Bangde raised his eyebrows, obviously not believing it, and asked suspiciously: "You are a newbie in the novice trial space, where did you get 500 energy crystals? As far as I know, the total number of energy crystals in each novice trial space is also No more than 100 pieces.”

"I encountered an encirclement and suppression by three tribes..."

After Zhao Bond heard this, he was horrified, and at the same time he admired Wang Shuo even more.

After a while, Zhao Bond said: "Today you repair the city wall first. At the same time, you can send your golden armored warriors to kill skeleton soldiers nearby. This will speed up the progress of the mission. During the entire mission, I cannot directly meddling."

After Wang Shuo heard this, he was very grateful to Zhao Bond.

So, I bought him some wine and food, and after taking a few bites, I devoted myself to the work of repairing the city wall.

The void battlefield, as the name suggests, is a battlefield located in the void.

And the ancient battlefield is just the tip of the iceberg.

Similarly, Yellow Wind Valley is only a very small area in the void battlefield.

Many great lords and city lords have always used the Void Battlefield as a place for military training. The materials produced there can greatly enhance the strength of the territory.

But at the same time, it is also full of dangers. If you are not careful, you may risk falling.

The wind and sand in the Yellow Wind Valley were very strong. Zhao Bonde held up an energy shield, enjoying the food, looking at the busy Wang Shuo, and recalling some of his past events.

Recalling the past can help restore memory, but excessive recollection will stimulate their incomplete memory and cause severe headaches.

Zhao Bondang has done this kind of thing not once or twice, so he is naturally very measured.

When he was bored, he often recalled how he came into this world, and how he withdrew from the road of hegemony and became a tool man.

These memories range from bitter to sweet.

What Zhao Bond has never been able to forget is a girl named Caiyi.
